Isn't that a cable wire? Suggesting electricity?

Second video I selected from this channel, and I'm thinking a fair amount of the content is for S&Gs. Dude on the horse has clear electricity in the community. The "primitive muscle-powered machine" isn't primitive but contemporary as a tool. Their clothes come from interactions with modernized society, meaning they need some kind of currency beyond simple bartering.

After the Philippines tunnel-people video, I though I'd found a channel with good content. Oh well.
